# 设置faceliveness的配置
##### 简要描述

- | 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| Enable | boolean | 是否使能人脸活体检测；false-否，true-是 | 是 |
| Score | float | 活体检测阈值,[0-100] | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceRecognition/FaceLivenessStatus HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 3214a2e6-414a-4782-b36a-08a6bba77e57
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 148

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<FaceLivenessStatus Version="1.0">
<Enable>true</Enable>
<Score>50</Score>
</FaceLivenessStatus>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 201

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceRecognition/FaceLivenessStatus</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceRecognition/FaceLivenessStatus` 

##### 请求方式

- put
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
{}

```
